title: Kendrick DigiFire 10
excerpt: A few days ago I ordered a dew control system controller from Kendrick Astro Instruments. I received it and everything seems to work. I still have to test the system in a condensation situation…
html: A few days ago I ordered a dew control system controller from Kendrick Astro Instruments. I received it and everything seems to work. I still have to test the system in a condensation situation. I really like the little label that says "Made in Canada".
